evidence.reason: In `run_case`, `mutated_files` is captured before the CLI call, but after the CLI only records/completions/units are read and `cleanup()` runs. There is no `repair_files()` observation before cleanup. For the `unsafe-metadata` case, `cleanup()` chmods the drop-in back to `original_mode`, so a controller chmod to `0600` is undone before the later preserved/baseline file comparison and goes undetected. The negative control therefore does not verify that the controller left the mutated fixture unchanged.
